purpose: Distinguish numerical root-finder basin failures from genuinely absent local image roots for P0657 fold 1 without changing its fitted physics or acceptance tolerance.

decision_rule.numerical_solver_limitation_if: either originally failed image has a finite solution within 5 arcsec and closure <= 1e-6 arcsec
decision_rule.local_topology_failure_if: an originally failed image has no accepted root across all 100 preregistered attempts
decision_rule.next_if_numerical: implement one universal robust solver and rescore every comparator; P0658 alone cannot advance P0657
decision_rule.next_if_topological: retain P0657 failure and do not tune diffusion strength from this audit

claim_boundary: P0657 parameters and profiled source positions are recomputed with its exact frozen fold, starts, and seed and must reproduce the stored optimizer cost.
No gravity parameter, source position, lens geometry, field amplitude, closure threshold, or physical formula is changed during the root search.
Accepted roots must lie within five arcseconds of the observed image so distant image branches cannot masquerade as recovery.
P0658 is diagnostic and cannot advance P0657 without a universal comparator rescore.
No sealed P0633 or P0640 outcome is opened.
